description: This PHP abstract class defines a base controller for handling file responses, specifically for serving files as downloadable attachments with proper headers and response configuration within a web application framework.

classes.name: AbstractFileController
classes.description: An abstract controller that provides common functionality for handling file download responses, including setting headers and managing file responses.

methods.name: getNewFileResponse
methods.description: Creates a new BinaryFileResponse object for a given file.

methods.name: getFileResponse
methods.description: Returns a BinaryFileResponse for a file, creating one if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: makeAttachmentDisposition
methods.description: Generates a Content-Disposition header value for attachment with filename encoding.

methods.name: setCommonHeadersToResponse
methods.description: Sets standard headers on a Response object for file download, including content type, length, disposition, cache control, and transfer encoding.
